'''Manpha''' was a [[Water|wet]] and [[swamp]]y [[planet]]<ref name="SWCENE" /> located in [[Manpha system]] of the [[Seitia sector]],<ref name="Appendix" /> a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Timelines" /> and the [[Western Reaches]].<ref name="WesternReaches" /> Situated in grid square K-20 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it was located on the [[super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine]], which linked it to the [[Tureen system|Tureen]] and [[Zastiga system]]s.<ref name="Timelines" /> Manpha was the [[homeworld]] of the amphibious [[Shawda Ubb]] [[species]], including the [[musician]] [[Rappertunie]].<ref name="SWCENE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Manpha was first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''.<ref name="SWCEUE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> The [[2017]] French-language book ''[[Créatures et peuples de la galaxie]]'' by [[Sabine Boccador]] misspelled the planet's name as "Monpha."<ref name="Creatures">''[[Créatures et peuples de la galaxie]]''</ref>

[[Manpha/Legends|Manpha]] was originally introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first mentioned in the [[1997]] ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was subsequently given its first visual depiction in the [[2006]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', which was written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] and [[Helen Keier]] and illustrated by [[Chris Trevas]] and [[William O'Connor]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
